## Research Notes
See `research.md`. One call site (`hooks/context-gauge.sh:100`) produces every row; guarding it with a read of
`<pdir>/.claude/project-status.json` → `.context.gauge_rows == true` delivers FR-001..003. The read follows the
`compact_at` pattern (`:93–97`): jq, stderr discarded, any failure → off. Two existing smoke blocks depend on the
rows being on and need the fixture opted in.

## Data Model
New optional key in `.claude/project-status.json`: `context.gauge_rows` — boolean, default `false`. Only the
JSON `true` enables rows. No other schema change.

## API Contracts
No API changes required. The gauge's CLI (stdin JSON, `--with-user`) is unchanged; only its default output shrinks.

## Implementation Approach
1. Tests first: opt the existing row fixtures in — write `{"context":{"gauge_rows":true}}` to
   `$l3_rn/.claude/project-status.json` and **`git add` it before the `--allow-empty` commit at
   `tests/smoke.sh:5492`**, so the linked worktree checks it out; set `gauge_rows: true` on the `$l3_t` fixture
   only around `la_gauge` (`:6127–6131`) and restore from `ps.bak` after. Then add the default-off and
   invalid-value checks **after the hour-age check (`:5501`) and before `rm -rf` (`:5502`)**, so every
   opted-in check of the block runs first — these fail on today's gauge.
2. Gauge: add `rows_on` and change the call line to `[ -n "$pdir" ] && rows_on "$pdir" && runs_rows "$pdir"`;
   update the `sed` pattern of the existing `g2.sh` mutation to match the new line (its `cmp` guard proves it).
   The always-on mutation uses the existing `l3_mut`/`l3_restore` helpers (`tests/smoke.sh:5363–5364`):
   `sed 's/rows_on "$pdir" \&\& //'` — the no-key check (SC-001) must go red.
3. Setup: header comment only; a smoke check runs setup (no flag and `--lanes`) and `cmp`s
   `project-status.json` before/after, and greps the written settings for `gauge_rows` (none).
4. Docs + CHANGELOG; a smoke grep check that each FR-005 doc names `gauge_rows`.

Trade-off: reading the key from `pdir` (not `dir`, where `compact_at` comes from) — chosen because the rows come
from `pdir`'s ledger, and `ledger_dir` already reads `$pdir/.claude/project-status.json` for `.board`
(`context-gauge.sh:42–44`); in the common case the two are the same folder.

Decision — linked worktrees: the key is read from the folder the session runs in (`pdir`), with no fallback to the
main worktree (the gauge's `.board` read has the same, existing behaviour). A project must track
`.claude/project-status.json` for the rows to show inside a worktree; `docs/quickstart.md` (and pt-BR) say so in
the status-line bullet. The `commondir` fallback (`ledger_dir:47–50`) is not adopted for this item.

The `docs/hooks.md:41` row edit also resolves its existing contradiction ("no ledger or git call" vs rows read
from the ledger): the ledger is read only with `context.gauge_rows: true`.

## Code Sketches (Mental Alignment)

### Sketch 1: the switch
**File:** `hooks/context-gauge.sh` (modify, new function before `emit` at `:78`, call at `:100`)
**Intent:** rows only when the project says `true`; any failure is off and the ledger is not read.

```bash
rows_on() { # $1 project folder → 0 only when .context.gauge_rows is the boolean true (HEF-23; default off)
  [ -f "$1/.claude/project-status.json" ] || return 1
  [ "$(jq -r '.context.gauge_rows == true' "$1/.claude/project-status.json" 2>/dev/null)" = true ]
}
…
[ -n "$pdir" ] && rows_on "$pdir" && runs_rows "$pdir"
exit 0
```

**Why this shape:** `== true` is false for `"true"`, `1`, `null`, absent (D2); invalid JSON → jq fails → empty →
off; `&&` short-circuit keeps the ledger unread (D3); `exit 0` stays last so a false guard never sets the rc.

### Sketch 2: default-off and invalid-value checks
**File:** `tests/smoke.sh` (modify, in the `l3_rn` block **after the hour-age check `:5501`, before `rm -rf` `:5502`**)
**Intent:** the same ledger (RN-1 claim still present) yields one line, rc 0, no stderr, without the key, with
every non-`true` value, and with invalid JSON.

```bash
# gauge-rows-opt-in/FR-001 gauge-rows-opt-in/FR-002: rows are opt-in
rm -f "$l3_rn/.claude/project-status.json"
l3_o="$(l3_rin "$l3_rn" | bash "$REPO/hooks/context-gauge.sh" 2>&1)"; l3_rc=$?
{ [ "$l3_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$l3_o" = 'ctx 12%' ]; } || { bad "…no key → one line, rc 0: $l3_o"; l3_fail=1; }
for v in '{"context":{"gauge_rows":"true"}}' '{"context":{"gauge_rows":1}}' '{"context":{"gauge_rows":null}}' \
         '{"context":{"gauge_rows":false}}' '{"context":"x"}' '{nope'; do
  printf '%s\n' "$v" > "$l3_rn/.claude/project-status.json"
  l3_o="$(l3_rin "$l3_rn" | bash "$REPO/hooks/context-gauge.sh" 2>&1)"; l3_rc=$?
  { [ "$l3_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$l3_o" = 'ctx 12%' ]; } || { bad "…$v → off, rc 0, no stderr: $l3_o"; l3_fail=1; }
done
```

**Why this shape:** reuses `l3_rin`/`sld` fixtures; `2>&1` folds stderr into the comparison and `l3_rc` captures
the exit code (FR-002 "rc 0, no stderr"); placed after every opted-in check so none of them sees the file
removed. Mutations: `sed 's/rows_on "$pdir" \&\& //'` (always on) must turn the no-key check red; `sed 's/==
true/!= null/'` must turn the `1`/`"true"`/`false` cases red (SC-004).

- [x] **1 — payload never under `.claude/`**: only `hooks/`, `docs/`, `tests/`, `CHANGELOG.md` change.
- [x] **2 — commands namespaced**: no command added or renamed — not applicable beyond that.
- [x] **3 — mutation-tested guards**: the new guard gets two mutations (always-on condition; guard removed via
  the existing `g2.sh` pattern) and the suite must go red for each.
- [x] **4 — zero-install**: bash + jq, already required by the gauge.
- [x] **5 — helpers fail loudly**: not applicable — the gauge is a status line whose contract is never to fail
  (`context-gauge.sh:13`); off-on-error is the specified behaviour, not a sentinel a caller reads.

## Risks & Mitigations
| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|--------|------------|
| Worktree fixture lacks `project-status.json` | opt-in row check fails from `wt` | `git add` the file before the `:5492` commit, so `worktree add` checks it out |
| Default-off checks remove the `$l3_rn` opt-in | later checks of the block go red | the default-off/invalid checks run last in the block (after `:5501`) |
| The `g2.sh` mutation `sed` stops matching the changed call line | mutation silently no-op | update its pattern; the existing `cmp` guard reports a non-applying sed |
| Users who relied on the rows lose them on upgrade | surprise | CHANGELOG + quickstart name the key to turn them back on |
| `$l3_t` fixture shared with later blocks | other checks see rows | set `gauge_rows` only around `la_gauge` and restore from `ps.bak` after |

## Quick Start
1. Add the failing default-off checks in `tests/smoke.sh` and opt the row fixtures in.
2. Add `rows_on` and guard the call in `hooks/context-gauge.sh`; update the `g2.sh` mutation pattern.
3. Update `hefesto-setup.sh` header, the three docs, CHANGELOG; add the setup and docs checks; run `tests/smoke.sh`.
